body:
Thank you for this clear write-up, @FlamingFireCoding. Engraved part numbers are a common need, and the plan reuses the right parts (Sketch, the Engrave/Trace generator, `face_frame`, the mark law).

Triage: `enhancement`, `P6` (accepted, not scheduled), `effort:high` (new toolpath input that reaches posted G-code, so the safety floor applies), `area:2d`. If the maintainer wants it for the next release, he can raise it to `P4` with his own words quoted here.

Clean-room notes:
- Glyph outlines must come only from a font that we already bundle under a permissive licence (`assets/ui/fonts/`, see `assets/ui/LICENSES.md`); no letter shapes or engraving fonts from another CAM product.
- Record the first ride mode (outline or single-line) in `docs/decisions/`, as the issue says.

What would help: one or two example parts with the text you want (string, height, face), and the tool you would use (v-bit angle or end mill size). A safe air cut, or a cut in wax or foam, is the best first test when it is ready.

PR #2819 is a first slice (`Refs #2679`). It does not close this issue.

Findings from the work on the first slice:

1. The repository holds no font file. `assets/ui/fonts/` does not exist on `main`. The UI text comes from the default fonts inside the `egui` crates. To read those outlines, we need a font parser as a new dependency. That decision is the maintainer's.
2. On `main`, an operation on a profile refuses generation by name. #1869 adds Engrave and Trace on sketch chains. #1869 depends on #1864 (PR #2716). The toolpath, the verify and the golden CL of this issue need #1869.

What the first slice does:

- It adds our own single-line stroke font, drawn from scratch: capital letters, digits, the space and `- _ . : / # + = ( )`.
- It adds the undoable command `InsertText` and the MCP tool `insert_text`. They place the typed text as a profile on the top face of the stock, at X, Y and an angle.
- A lower-case letter is refused by name. It is not changed to a capital.
- The text profile saves and loads with the project. `move_dxf_profile` moves it.

Open work for this issue after the first slice:

- The Engrave toolpath, verify, post and golden CL on a text profile (after #1869).
- The UI: type the text, pick the spot, set the height.
- The text as an editable parameter.
- Lower-case glyphs, and an outline font if the maintainer approves the dependency.
- The row for `insert_text` in the `camcraft-mcp` skill file.

`docs/decisions/2679-engrave-typed-text.md` in the PR records the choices.
